decision.reasoning_trace: I filtered the list to focus on actual backpacks, as the feed included many camping accessories like pillows, towels, and tools. From the remaining options, prod_backpacks_057 (QT&QY 45L Military Tactical Backpack) is the strongest candidate due to its high rating of 4.7 stars across over 6,000 reviews and a very competitive price of $39.99. I also evaluated the Maxpedition (prod_backpacks_038) for its build quality and the High Sierra (prod_backpacks_068) for long-distance hiking needs. I excluded the Granite Gear Virga 2 (prod_backpacks_041) as a final choice because multiple reviews highlighted issues with the shoulder straps breaking. Ultimately, the QT&QY pack offers the best balance of capacity, features, and proven durability for its cost.
